answer_1.quote: This study addresses a critical gap in MT by developing parallel corpora for low-resourced Middle Eastern languages-PARME, with the ultimate goal of facilitating MT development.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs are machine-translated text in the target languages from English or other source languages, evaluated for translation quality.

answer_2.quote: We employ BLEU ... which calculates n-gram precision with a brevity penalty ... We also use chrF ... for our baseline system which computes character-level n-gram F-scores.
